about: BUDGET-CAPS (meta docs/plans/BUDGET-CAPS-PLAN.md; J439 as amended by J444). Each budget's one hard cap, with the J-number that set it. A hard cap moves only with a new J-number from Jake. A key ending in /* covers every key under it. hard null: no hard cap on record (D3), the baseline alone guards it. target: a line the player is warned at and nothing is refused (J445). kind floor: hard is a minimum. floor: the least rise that counts as a regression for a noisy measure. The baselines are in budgets/baselines.json; node scripts/budgets/cli.mjs check | record | declare.

download/phone/*.why: A shard's phone download: up to 50 MB is fine and prints nothing, 100 MB is the hard ceiling (Jake 2026-11-13).

memory/loading/*.why: A zone's modelled phone memory while loading: 1.5 GB is the one memory refusal (J410, J431, J445); the phone shows Play anyway (J431).

memory/playing/*.why: A zone's modelled phone memory while playing: 1.0 GB is a target that shows the may-crash card, never a refusal (J445 amends J410 and J429).

ledger/*.why: The memory ledger's control and peak totals a zone (BC6): a regression check against the zone's own baseline; the hard line is memory/loading/*.

js/title/gzip.why: No hard cap on record; the raw cap is J324's (D3).

webkit-ledger/*.why: The native WebKit memory ledger's control and peak totals a zone (Nine, BC6): the same regression check as ledger/*.

footprint/*.why: The Template's settled native WebContent on the online boot (memory-footprint.yml, BC11): a regression check against its own baseline; the hard line is memory/loading/*.

walk/*.why: A zone's allocation rate over its 60 s walk (memory-footprint.yml, BC11): the floor is 5 MB over the walk. No hard cap on record (D3).

nine/boot/*.why: Nine's boot at control in ci's nine-ring1 load (BC11): CPU geometry still reachable from the scene, and the live JS heap after a full collection. No hard cap on record (D3); held spawn parts fail the load on their own. Floor 5 MB like every memory total: retained geometry at control moves ~2 MB with when uploads release (retained plus released is constant).

nine/boot/live-heap.why: Nine's collected live heap at control (BC11). J431 treats a small overage as noise and requires a three-boot median for a regression.

nine/street/triangles95.why: NB6: the most triangles submitted at p95 in any minute of Nine's phone street walk (ci-reports, BC11). No hard cap on record (D3).

nine/street/draws95.why: NB6: the most draw calls at p95 in any minute of Nine's phone street walk (ci-reports, BC11). No hard cap on record (D3).

render/phone-low/triangles/*.why: J444: phone Low triangles in the fixed headless spawn views, compared with the zone's own pinned revision.

render/phone-low/draws/*.why: J444: phone Low draws in the fixed headless spawn views, compared with the zone's own pinned revision.

render/phone-low/programs/*.why: J444: phone Low programs in the fixed headless spawn views, compared with the zone's own pinned revision.

render/phone-high/programs/*.why: J444, meta QA-FEEDBACK-2026-11-24 row 57: phone High programs in the fixed headless spawn views, compared with the zone's own pinned revision (High linked 39 programs after control at Driftwood's dock until 2cac25df5).

fps/phone-low/driftwood-isle.why: Driftwood drawn-frame minimum. DF7 qualifies the full route and its segments nightly.

fps/phone-lpm-low/driftwood-isle.why: Driftwood drawn-frame minimum. DF7 qualifies the full route and its segments nightly.

fps/phone-high/driftwood-isle.why: Driftwood drawn-frame minimum. DF7 qualifies the full route and its segments nightly.

fps/desktop-medium/driftwood-isle.why: Driftwood drawn-frame minimum (J464) for desktop Medium at half CPU speed; J495 gave the 2x case to Medium. DF7 qualifies it nightly.

fps/desktop-native/driftwood-isle.why: Driftwood drawn-frame minimum. DF7 qualifies the full route and its segments nightly.
